name: temporal-entity-state
description: Entity state changes over time. Answers must respect the time context of the question — pre/post event retrieval must differ.

facts: Bear Stearns was an independent investment bank headquartered in New York, known for mortgage-backed securities
In March 2008, during the financial crisis, JPMorgan Chase acquired Bear Stearns in a fire sale backed by the Fed
Chase Manhattan was purchased by J.P. Morgan in 2000, forming JPMorgan Chase
After 2008, Bear Stearns existed only as a brand under JPMorgan Chase until it was fully absorbed
cases.question: Who owned Bear Stearns before the financial crisis?
cases.expected_answer: Bear Stearns was independent — publicly held shareholders, no parent company.

facts: Facebook rebranded its parent company to Meta Platforms in October 2021
The Facebook app itself kept the name Facebook after the rebrand
Instagram and WhatsApp are owned by the same parent company since their acquisitions (2012, 2014)
cases.question: Did Instagram belong to Meta when it was acquired?
reasoning_chain: => acquired by Facebook Inc., which is today's Meta
cases.expected_answer: No — it was acquired in 2012 by Facebook, Inc.; the parent was renamed Meta in 2021. Same entity, earlier name.
